title: Stop Module execution when approval is cancelled
goal: Ensure a task cancelled while awaiting explicit Module approval never emits moduleInvoked or executes the Module.
context: ModuleRuntime awaits ApprovalGate and then proceeds directly to input validation/invocation. If a gate suspends and later returns approval after the caller cancels, the runtime must re-check cancellation before crossing the execution boundary.
forbidden_changes: Do not treat a cancelled approval as a grant.
Do not change policy denial or capability checks.
Do not modify Skill mapping, UI, or provider behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation after an approval request but before its resolution ends the module run as cancelled.
The event log records moduleCancelled and never moduleInvoked for the cancelled run.
An approval that completes while the task remains active still follows normal policy and capability checks.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If cancellation tests expose a race, preserve the gate's cancellation behavior and add a final cancellation check immediately before module invocation.
